task.description:
Implement Epic 4 compensation and restore reconciliation for EXP-401 and EXP-402.

Follow the design artefact and backlog source. Keep the transition function I/O-free. Ensure compensation is first-class in engine events and restore reconciliation uses wait descriptors from EXP-103.

Deliver code/migrations/tests as needed and validate with zig build, zig build test, and zig build migrate.

Run any necessary error-set validation before self-review.
acceptance_criteria: No I/O added to transition function

result.summary: Implemented EXP-401 compensation validation and EXP-402 restore reconciliation with restored-orphan status handling.
